mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.factory_code, c.calendar_date, c.is_production_day AS production_day, c.allocation_weight, c.daily_capacity, c.capacity_unit, c.revision, c.reason, c.created_by, c.created_at, c.updated_by, c.updated_at, cu.display_name AS created_by_name, uu.display_name AS updated_by_name FROM mrp_production_calendar c LEFT JOIN user cu ON cu.id = c.created_by LEFT JOIN user uu ON uu.id = c.updated_by c.factory_code=#{factoryCode} ORDER BY factory_code, calendar_date

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mrp_production_calendar (factory_code, calendar_date, is_production_day, allocation_weight, daily_capacity, capacity_unit, revision, reason, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{factoryCode}, #{calendarDate}, #{productionDay}, #{allocationWeight}, #{dailyCapacity}, #{capacityUnit}, COALESCE(#{revision},0), #{reason}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE mrp_production_calendar SET is_production_day=#{productionDay}, allocation_weight=#{allocationWeight}, daily_capacity=#{dailyCapacity}, capacity_unit=#{capacityUnit}, revision=COALESCE(revision,0)+1, reason=#{reason}, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.factory_code, c.calendar_date, c.is_production_day AS production_day, c.allocation_weight, c.daily_capacity, c.capacity_unit, c.revision, c.reason, c.created_by, c.created_at, c.updated_by, c.updated_at, cu.display_name AS created_by_name, uu.display_name AS updated_by_name FROM mrp_production_calendar c LEFT JOIN `user` cu ON cu.id=c.created_by LEFT JOIN `user` uu ON uu.id=c.updated_by WHERE c.factory_code=#{factoryCode} AND c.calendar_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY c.calendar_date
mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE calendar_dates AS ( SELECT CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE) AS calendar_date UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(calendar_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM calendar_dates WHERE calendar_date < CAST(#{endDate} AS DATE) )
